headline: Quiet week refining Cursor tooling
narrative: Focused on cursor-commands and shipflow, contributing PRs and iterating on the vision. Less posting, more building. Dream pop and trip hop soundtracking the deep work in Stockholm's overcast winter.

sections.title: Cursor tooling
sections.content: Working on cursor-commands and shipflow—point-and-click editing for Next.js powered by Cursor Agent. Contributed a PR to the cursor-commands repo, iterating on the interaction model. 24 commits across focused sessions, most active on November 26th. Building tools that let you move between high-level ideas and surgical edits without leaving flow.

sections.title: Building in public
sections.content: Quiet week on X, but recent posts capture the vision: 'from codebase to roadmap with cursor', 'surgical moves > sweeping one shots', 'you set the vision, agents do the execution'. The theme: making building software easier and more fun through AI agents as collaborators.

footer: Overcast Stockholm winter, short days. Building tools in the quiet, dream pop in the background.
